title: pendingPhUSD / pendingStable views revert (Panic 0x11) for a post-pauseWithdraw user instead of returning 0 (off-chain integration DoS)
description: After a partial pauseWithdraw leaves stale debt (same precondition as M-02), pendingPhUSD/pendingStable compute (smaller amount * accPerShare)/PRECISION - (larger debt) and revert with Panic 0x11 (L489 and the pendingStable analogue) instead of returning 0. Off-chain consumers expecting a uint256 get a revert -> integration DoS. No on-chain asset impact.
impact: Off-chain integration availability only. Dashboards/integrators reading these views for an affected user hit the underflow revert. No funds at risk from the view itself; the underlying on-chain brick is carried by M-02.
attackPath: 1. User does a partial pauseWithdraw (stale debt, as in M-02).
2. Any caller of pendingPhUSD(user)/pendingStable(user) hits the underflow and the view reverts.
3. Off-chain consumers expecting a uint256 get a revert -> integration DoS.
recommendation: Clamp the views: return 0 when (amount * accPerShare)/PRECISION < debt instead of subtracting unconditionally (e.g. use a saturating subtraction). Pairs with the M-02 on-chain debt-rebase fix.

tier3Verification.detail: Tier-3 CONFIRMED: SYMBOLIC-003/004 FAIL; INV-01 violation shared with M-02. Kept separate from M-02 (off-chain DoS vs account brick; clamp-view vs rebase-debt fix).

borderlineFlag: None - view-function revert -> Low/QA (the underlying on-chain brick is carried by M-02).
